title: Interdict invariants
description: Constraints a consumer may rely on. Each is enforced by a validator or a runtime assertion in the backend, and covered by a test.

invariants.rule: A Finding with verdict != 'inconclusive' MUST have non-empty evidence.
invariants.rationale: A hallucinated verdict cannot reach adjudication if it cannot cite.

invariants.rule: outcome == 'RELEASE' requires >= 2 independent supporting agents, one of which is callback with verdict 'supports'.
case.exposure_amount == sum(amount of payments in held_payment_ids).
invariants.enforced_by: models/domain.py Case.assert_exposure_matches, called by services/payments.py on every mutation

invariants.rule: State transitions must appear in LEGAL_TRANSITIONS; anything else raises IllegalTransition.
A side effect is applied at most once per idempotency_key, across crashes.
invariants.enforced_by: store/base.py Repository.record_effect (compare-and-set); services/payments.py short-circuits on created=False

invariants.rule: Full account and routing numbers are NEVER stored or transmitted; only 4-digit fragments.
A Precedent MUST carry a non-empty rationale. A resolution with no reasoning cannot be cited in an adjudication.
invariants.rationale: Same reasoning as INV-1, applied to human decisions: a position that cannot show its work must not carry weight.

invariants.rule: Money is partitioned by tenant_id. A case, vendor or payment listing scoped to a tenant NEVER returns another tenant's rows. Tradecraft in the threat exchange is deliberately NOT partitioned.
invariants.enforced_by: store/base.py Repository list_* tenant_id filters; platform/exchange.py LocalExchange.lookup

invariants.rule: Every timestamp originates from the injected Clock, never the wall clock.
